content: Hi Jamie, I’m putting together a visit plan for Riverside plant on December 2. We have a crew of 3 entering through the north gate to work on pump P-14. Do you have any practical tips or precautions I should include in the plan?
The site coordinator recommends using the south gate because it is closer to pump P-14 and may save walking time; the north gate remains open and valid.
